question: Should OpenClaw expose a plugin-visible skill install/update completion observer, and what redacted payload plus observer-failure semantics should it use?
rationale: Source inspection proves the completion lifecycle surface is missing, but only maintainers can decide what install metadata plugins may see and whether observer failures can affect an already-written install.

options.title: Add Minimal Observer
options.body: Add a non-blocking completion hook with redacted target, provenance, outcome, timestamp, and documented fail-open logging semantics.

options.title: Keep Pre-Install Only
options.body: Declare `security.installPolicy` and `before_install` sufficient for install security and close or narrow this issue to documentation.

options.title: Defer To Trust Roadmap
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer implementation until a broader ClawHub trust/provenance API defines lifecycle auditing.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Observer
recommendation.body: Add a non-blocking completion hook with redacted target, provenance, outcome, timestamp, and documented fail-open logging semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision sits at the ClawHub skill-install product boundary that steipete introduced and already discussed on the issue.
